 The 75th Miss Universe final takes place on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, at the Coliseo de Puerto Rico José Miguel Agrelot in San Juan, and you can watch it live on Telemundo and Peacock in the US and on REELZ. Fátima Bosch of Mexico will crown her successor, and India is represented by 19-year-old Kaziah Liz Mejo of Kerala. This guide has the schedule, start times in the US, UK and India, and every way to watch.
 Last updated on November 10, 2026. Hosts, judges and performers have not been confirmed consistently across outlets, so we will add them here once they are announced.

 Miss Universe 2026 at a Glance
 Detail Miss Universe 2026 
 Final Tuesday, November 24, 2026 
 Start time 8 p.m. in San Juan, which is 7 p.m. ET and 4 p.m. PT (REELZ lists its broadcast at 8 p.m. ET) 
 Where to watch Telemundo and Peacock (US), REELZ 
 Venue Coliseo de Puerto Rico José Miguel Agrelot, San Juan, Puerto Rico 
 Edition 75th Miss Universe, the Diamond anniversary 
 Defending titleholder Fátima Bosch, Mexico (Miss Universe 2025) 
 India’s contestant Kaziah Liz Mejo, Miss Universe India 2026 
 Miss Universe 2026 Schedule: Costume Show, Preliminary and Final
 Three ticketed events take place at the Coliseo in San Juan, which holds about 18,500 people. San Juan is an hour ahead of Eastern time in November, so the evening events start at 7 p.m. and 8 p.m. local time.
 Event Date San Juan time Eastern time India (IST) 
 National Costume Show Saturday, November 21 7 p.m. 6 p.m. 4:30 a.m., Sunday 
 Preliminary Competition Sunday, November 22 7 p.m. 6 p.m. 4:30 a.m., Monday 
 75th Miss Universe Final Tuesday, November 24 8 p.m. 7 p.m. 5:30 a.m., Wednesday 
 In the UK, the final starts at midnight on Wednesday, November 25. Broadcasters list slightly different start times for the final, so check your local listings before the night. REELZ shows the final at 8 p.m. ET, while Telemundo’s listing is 7 p.m. ET.
 How to Watch Miss Universe 2026
 Telemundo: the Spanish-language broadcast airs live on your local Telemundo station, and the channel number varies by market and provider.
 Peacock: streams the final live alongside Telemundo and requires an eligible subscription. Peacock lists Miss Universe 2026 on November 24.
 REELZ: broadcasts the competition on the REELZ channel and streams it on REELZ+, with a free trial for new users, in the REELZ+ iPhone and Android apps. REELZ also streams all three events on YouTube for REELZ All Access members.
 Outside the US, availability depends on your local broadcaster or streaming service, and many fans follow the results on the pageant’s official channels. We will add international options here when broadcasters confirm them.
 Who Is Miss Universe India 2026, Kaziah Liz Mejo?
 Kaziah Liz Mejo, 19, from Mavelikkara in Kerala’s Alappuzha district, won Miss Universe India 2026 at the grand finale in Jaipur on August 23. Gulf News, Khaleej Times and Outlook India report that she was raised in Abu Dhabi, won Miss Universe Kerala earlier this year and was crowned by the reigning Miss Universe India, Manika Vishwakarma. Vaishnavi Gannesh of Tamil Nadu was first runner-up and Anushri Satavlekar of Gujarat was second runner-up.
 India has won Miss Universe three times: Sushmita Sen in 1994, Lara Dutta in 2000 and Harnaaz Sandhu in 2021, and Kaziah is aiming for a fourth crown. Read our reports on Harnaaz Sandhu’s 2021 win and the full Miss Universe winners list from 1952 to 2025 .
 The Defending Titleholder and the 75th Anniversary
 Fátima Bosch of Mexico won the 74th Miss Universe in Thailand on November 21, 2025, and she will crown her successor in San Juan. Puerto Rico was announced as host of the 75th edition in September 2025, bringing the pageant back to the island after more than two decades. Organizers have described the week as a celebration of the 75th anniversary with cultural and social events around the three televised nights.
 What to Watch Next
 Thanksgiving week is full of live TV. See our best TV shows to watch in November 2026 for what streams on Peacock, Netflix and Prime Video this month.
 Miss Universe 2026 FAQ
 When is the Miss Universe 2026 final?
 Tuesday, November 24, 2026, at the Coliseo de Puerto Rico José Miguel Agrelot in San Juan.
 What time is the Miss Universe 2026 final?
 It starts at 8 p.m. in San Juan, which is 7 p.m. ET and 4 p.m. PT. REELZ lists its broadcast at 8 p.m. ET. In India it is 5:30 a.m. IST on Wednesday, November 25.
 Where can I watch Miss Universe 2026 in the US?
 Live on Telemundo and Peacock, and on the REELZ channel and REELZ+.
 When is the Miss Universe 2026 preliminary competition?
 Sunday, November 22, at 7 p.m. in San Juan (6 p.m. ET). The National Costume Show is on Saturday, November 21 at the same time.
 Who represents India at Miss Universe 2026?
 Kaziah Liz Mejo, 19, from Mavelikkara, Kerala, who was crowned Miss Universe India 2026 in Jaipur on August 23.
 Who is the reigning Miss Universe?
 Fátima Bosch of Mexico, who won Miss Universe 2025 in Thailand.
 Which edition of Miss Universe is this?
 The 75th edition, the Diamond anniversary.
 How many times has India won Miss Universe?
 Three times: Sushmita Sen (1994), Lara Dutta (2000) and Harnaaz Sandhu (2021).
 Sources: schedule, venue and broadcast details are from the Miss Universe Organization’s announcements as reported by Hola, DIRECTV, REELZ and Wikipedia, and Peacock’s November listings. India details are from Gulf News, Khaleej Times, Outlook India and Free Press Journal. This page is not affiliated with the Miss Universe Organization or any broadcaster.
